evals.name: gate-one-before-any-worker
evals.expected_output: Records the starting commit, then asks one multi-select AskUserQuestion naming the four sub-topics (memories, hooks, skills, AGENTS.md) and launches no worker and no child skill until the answer is in.
assertions: The first tool call after the scratch file is AskUserQuestion with the four sub-topics
No Agent, Skill or codex call precedes the answer
Only the selected sub-topics are gathered afterwards

evals.name: gate-two-approves-every-item
evals.prompt: Gathering is done: 9 memory rows, 6 hook rows, 2 candidates and 3 AGENTS.md lines are in the table.
evals.expected_output: Asks sub-topic by sub-topic, flagged items first, up to four items per AskUserQuestion call with one question per item, closes each sub-topic with a confirm-all for its clean set, writes every verdict into the scratch table, and only then runs the appliers.
assertions: Every row receives its own verdict before any apply
No file outside the scratch dir changes before gate 2 closes
The children are re-run with the argument apply and the scratch file path

evals.name: continues-when-a-child-is-absent
evals.prompt: Run the full clankers review with memories and hooks. The hooks-review skill is not installed on this machine.
evals.expected_output: Gathers the memory half, says that the hooks sub-topic is unavailable because its SKILL.md is absent, runs gate 2 and the apply on the memory rows, and still runs the closing chain over the commits that exist.
assertions: Names the unavailable sub-topic instead of stopping
The memory half still runs through gather, gate 2 and apply
The closing chain still runs over the commits that exist

evals.name: closing-chain-adversarial-review
evals.prompt: Every verdict is applied and committed. Finish the pass.
evals.expected_output: Runs an independent adversarial review with a different model (codex when on the path, read-only sandbox) against the range from the recorded starting commit plus the verdict table, applies high-confidence findings as a fixup commit, declines the rest with cause in the report, and closes by recommending the built-in /doctor checkup to the user.
assertions: The reviewer is a different model, not a self-review
The review checks deletes gone, keeps untouched, trims lossless, rule changes cased, new code sound
Each finding ends applied or declined-with-cause
Recommends /doctor to the user rather than claiming to run it
